summary: Created and installed “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. The CA remained operational and trusted after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created a 4096-bit RSA root CA with critical CA and certificate-signing extensions.
Stored the private key at /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key with mode 600.
Installed the certificate at /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem and refreshed RHEL’s system trust store.
Functionally verified trust using temporary leaf certificates before and after reboot.
Rebooted node1 safely; its boot ID changed and the system recovered to running with no failed units.

evidence.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA on node1
evidence.summary: Proves the final self-signed certificate has the requested name, valid CA extensions, a matching protected private key, and fingerprint 42:9F:29:61:30:E5:5B:D9:E0:66:48:AD:66:5B:E5:71:FF:8C:70:B8:89:34:A8:67:42:EC:F3:D3:FB:15:03:EC.

evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: Shows p11-kit classifies the certificate as a trust anchor, RHEL’s extracted system bundle validates it, and a leaf issued by it verifies successfully through that bundle.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline, safe reboot acknowledgement, boot-ID change from 19b555a2-ea96-4a98-9707-cc30f42c739e to f50ee944-ed5a-4ef4-b408-576b3b66dad7, restored system-running state with no failed units, persisted CA/key/anchor, and successful post-restart leaf issuance and system-trust verification.
